title: a draft is a .yaml or .yml file (or - for stdin) of at most 64 KiB; any other input, a missing argument or an extra one is rejected before anything is written
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D7 and the drafts rows of the other decisions (a just-in-time build is a draft kept in .jitso/drafts/ and validated by code)
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-15, drafts; docs/decisions.md D7). The input is a path ending in `.yaml` or `.yml`, or `-`, and holds at most 64 KiB (read with a limit, so a device or an endless file cannot fill memory: the case reads a symlink to /dev/zero). A path with another extension, an oversized input and no argument at all are `JITSO REJECTED: a draft is a .yaml file (or - for stdin) of at most 64 KiB`; a second word or a flag is `JITSO REJECTED: unknown argument "<x>"`; a file that cannot be read is `JITSO REJECTED: cannot read <path>: <reason>`. All exit 2 and write nothing.
